About Nifty Websites Australia.

Nifty Websites Australia is an Australian web design agency that builds strategic websites for small and growing businesses. We combine conversion-focused design with a complete SEO build on every site, so clients get websites that are found on Google and turn visitors into enquiries.

Who we are

An Australian team that builds to perform.

Australian-owned, with over 25 years of combined web experience.

Strategy first

We build around your customers and goals, not just how the site looks.

SEO on every site

A complete SEO build is included on every website we make.

Real support

A local team you can reach, with care plans to keep your site healthy.

How we work

Honest, fixed-price, built to last.

Fixed pricing

A fixed, itemised quote confirmed before any work begins.

Fast turnaround

A first draft within 48 hours on Starter and 5 working days on Professional.

No false promises

We build to the standard that ranks, and never sell page-one guarantees.

How it works

How a project works with us.

Discovery

We learn your business, your customers and the searches that matter, then agree the goals for the site.

Design for approval

We design a mobile-first concept built around conversion and your brand, for you to approve before we build.

Build and free SEO

We build fast and secure, then add the complete SEO build, content, schema, technical setup and analytics.

Launch and support

We go live, connect tracking, and back you with Australian support and optional care plans.

Common questions

About Nifty, answered.

Who are Nifty Websites Australia?

Nifty Websites Australia is an Australian web design agency that builds strategic websites for small and growing businesses. We combine conversion-focused design with a complete SEO build on every site, so clients get websites that are found on Google and turn visitors into enquiries.

How long have you been building websites?

We are an Australian-owned team with over 25 years of combined web experience, building and optimising websites for businesses across the country.

What makes Nifty different?

We build design and SEO together, include a complete SEO build on every site, quote a fixed price before we start, and back it with Australian support. You get a site that is made to rank and convert, not just to look good.

Do you only work with businesses in one city?

No. We are an Australian team working with businesses Australia-wide, remotely and efficiently, with local web design pages for cities and towns across the country.
